title: Nonblocking Partial Chunk Conformance and Tool Fallback Regression
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a deterministic regression harness that exercises nonblocking/partial-stream behavior across model variants and structured-output toolcall fallbacks. The goal is to catch regressions where partial-chunking (fragmented NDJSON/JSON pieces) combined with interleaved tool invocations causes schema corruption, duplicate tool calls, or silent truncation. This ticket covers: (1) a golden-prompt corpus that intentionally creates partial JSON boundaries and toolcall interleaves, (2) a lightweight oracle that validates partial-repair heuristics and idempotency, (3) CI job matrix permutations for sequence length, batch sizes, kv-cache priming, and model-variant shims, and (4) automatic gating rules and flakiness thresholds to avoid noisy failures in stable branches.
acceptance_criteria: Golden corpus of >=120 prompts covering edgecases (split tokens, nested schema, toolcall-midstream) checked in
Regression runner that can replay captured sessions and assert token-level and schema-level fidelity
CI matrix job (conformance/stream-partial) added to changelist pipeline with clear pass/fail thresholds
Automatic golden-update PR workflow: failing golden -> generate candidate diff -> requires PM + Eng approval
Metrics surfaced in console dashboard: token-regression-rate, toolcall-dup-rate, partial-json-repair-rate

2026-03-05 - Marcus Huang: Added CI matrix entries for sequence_len=[64,512,2048], batch=[1,8,32], kv_priming=[none,partial]. Observed flaky failures concentrated at seq=2048 batch=32 on quantized variants.
2026-03-10 - Reliability sync (Omar Patel): Agree to add a 3% flakiness budget and an auto-retry with jitter in the runner. Will track stable baseline over 2 weeks before promoting to mainline gate.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Huang: Submitted PR to runtime repo with harness and sample golden corpus. CI job currently opt-in under 'conformance/stream-partial'.
test_plan_steps: Check out golden corpus and run local replay harness against model-variant stable/quant/float32
Run repair heuristics in sequence and record schema-acceptance-rate and token-diff fingerprints
Execute CI matrix in forked pipeline to measure flakiness across permutations
If failures exceed flakiness budget: open auto-generated issue with failing seed and attach stderr + reconstructed partial stream
Promote job to protected gate only after baseline stability for 14 days
